```{python}
#| label: helpers
#| warning: false
#| output: false
def _find_pipeline_parquets(metric_key, q_val, base_dir=PIPELINE_TWITTER_FULL):
    m_path = Path(base_dir) / f"M_{metric_key}_q{q_val}.parquet"
    n_path = Path(base_dir) / f"N_{metric_key}_q{q_val}.parquet"
    if m_path.exists() and n_path.exists():
        return m_path, n_path
    return None, None


def _load_pipeline_mn(m_path, n_path, run_kmax):
    con = duckdb.connect()
    cols_info = con.execute(f"DESCRIBE SELECT * FROM read_parquet('{m_path}')").fetchall()
    exposure_cols = [c[0] for c in cols_info if c[0] != "user_id"]
    sum_stmt = ", ".join([f'SUM("{c}") AS "{c}"' for c in exposure_cols])

    m_sums = con.execute(f"SELECT {sum_stmt} FROM read_parquet('{m_path}')").fetchone()
    n_sums = con.execute(f"SELECT {sum_stmt} FROM read_parquet('{n_path}')").fetchone()
    con.close()

    M = np.zeros(run_kmax, dtype=float)
    N = np.zeros(run_kmax, dtype=float)
    for i, col_name in enumerate(exposure_cols):
        k = int(col_name)
        if 1 <= k <= run_kmax:
            M[k - 1] = float(m_sums[i])
            N[k - 1] = float(n_sums[i])
    return M, N


def load_twitter_data(q, metric, run_kmax=50, base_dir=PIPELINE_TWITTER_FULL, adopters_only=False):
    metric_key = "k" if metric == "k" else "kappa"
    m_path, n_path = _find_pipeline_parquets(metric_key, float(q), base_dir=base_dir)
    if m_path is None:
        return np.zeros(run_kmax), np.zeros(run_kmax)
    if not adopters_only:
        return _load_pipeline_mn(m_path, n_path, run_kmax)

    b_path = Path(base_dir) / "B_vector.parquet"
    if not b_path.exists():
        return np.zeros(run_kmax), np.zeros(run_kmax)

    m_df = pd.read_parquet(m_path)
    n_df = pd.read_parquet(n_path)
    b_df = pd.read_parquet(b_path)[["user_id", "adopted"]].copy()
    b_df["user_id"] = b_df["user_id"].astype(str)
    b_df = b_df[b_df["adopted"].astype(bool)][["user_id"]]

    m_df["user_id"] = m_df["user_id"].astype(str)
    n_df["user_id"] = n_df["user_id"].astype(str)
    m_df = m_df.merge(b_df, on="user_id", how="inner")
    n_df = n_df.merge(b_df, on="user_id", how="inner")

    valid_cols = [c for c in m_df.columns if str(c).isdigit()]
    valid_cols = sorted(valid_cols, key=lambda x: int(str(x)))
    M = np.zeros(run_kmax, dtype=float)
    N = np.zeros(run_kmax, dtype=float)
    if not valid_cols:
        return M, N

    m_sums = m_df[valid_cols].sum(axis=0)
    n_sums = n_df[valid_cols].sum(axis=0)

    for k_val in valid_cols:
        k = int(str(k_val))
        if k == 0:
            continue
        if k > run_kmax:
            break
        idx = k - 1
        M[idx] = float(m_sums[k_val])
        N[idx] = float(n_sums[k_val])

    return M, N


def load_twitter_mn_matrices(q, metric, base_dir=PIPELINE_TWITTER_FULL, adopters_only=False):
    metric_key = "k" if metric == "k" else "kappa"
    m_path, n_path = _find_pipeline_parquets(metric_key, float(q), base_dir=base_dir)
    if m_path is None or n_path is None:
        return None, None, []

    m_df = pd.read_parquet(m_path)
    n_df = pd.read_parquet(n_path)

    if adopters_only:
        b_path = Path(base_dir) / "B_vector.parquet"
        if not b_path.exists():
            return None, None, []
        b_df = pd.read_parquet(b_path)[["user_id", "adopted"]].copy()
        b_df["user_id"] = b_df["user_id"].astype(str)
        b_df = b_df[b_df["adopted"].astype(bool)][["user_id"]]
        m_df["user_id"] = m_df["user_id"].astype(str)
        n_df["user_id"] = n_df["user_id"].astype(str)
        m_df = m_df.merge(b_df, on="user_id", how="inner")
        n_df = n_df.merge(b_df, on="user_id", how="inner")

    if "user_id" in m_df.columns and "user_id" in n_df.columns:
        m_df = m_df.sort_values("user_id").reset_index(drop=True)
        n_df = n_df.sort_values("user_id").reset_index(drop=True)

    valid_cols = [c for c in m_df.columns if str(c).isdigit()]
    valid_cols = sorted(valid_cols, key=lambda x: int(str(x)))

    M_mat = m_df[valid_cols].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    N_mat = n_df[valid_cols].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    col_levels = [int(str(c)) for c in valid_cols]
    return M_mat, N_mat, col_levels


def _resolve_oo_mn_paths(data_name):
    base = DATA_PROCESSED_BASE / "oo"
    names = [str(data_name)]
    if str(data_name).endswith("_exposures"):
        names.append(str(data_name).replace("_exposures", ""))

    for name in names:
        d = base / name
        m_dir = d / "M.parquet"
        n_dir = d / "N.parquet"
        if d.is_dir() and m_dir.exists() and n_dir.exists():
            return m_dir, n_dir, name

        m_flat = base / f"{name}_M.parquet"
        n_flat = base / f"{name}_N.parquet"
        if m_flat.exists() and n_flat.exists():
            return m_flat, n_flat, name

    return None, None, None


def load_oo_data(data_name, run_kmax=50):
    m_path, n_path, _ = _resolve_oo_mn_paths(data_name)
    if m_path is None or n_path is None:
        return np.zeros(run_kmax), np.zeros(run_kmax)

    m_df = pd.read_parquet(m_path)
    n_df = pd.read_parquet(n_path)

    valid_cols = [c for c in m_df.columns if str(c).isdigit()]
    valid_cols = sorted(valid_cols, key=lambda x: int(str(x)))

    M_arr = np.zeros(run_kmax)
    N_arr = np.zeros(run_kmax)

    m_sums = m_df[valid_cols].sum(axis=0)
    n_sums = n_df[valid_cols].sum(axis=0)

    for k_val in valid_cols:
        k = int(str(k_val))
        if k == 0:
            continue
        if k > run_kmax:
            break
        idx = k - 1
        M_arr[idx] = float(m_sums[k_val])
        N_arr[idx] = float(n_sums[k_val])

    return M_arr, N_arr


def load_oo_mn_matrices(data_name, drop_zero_bin=True):
    m_path, n_path, _ = _resolve_oo_mn_paths(data_name)
    if m_path is None or n_path is None:
        return None, None, []

    m_df = pd.read_parquet(m_path)
    n_df = pd.read_parquet(n_path)

    valid_cols = [c for c in m_df.columns if str(c).isdigit()]
    valid_cols = sorted(valid_cols, key=lambda x: int(str(x)))
    if drop_zero_bin:
        valid_cols = [c for c in valid_cols if int(str(c)) >= 1]

    M_mat = m_df[valid_cols].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    N_mat = n_df[valid_cols].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    col_levels = [int(str(c)) for c in valid_cols]
    return M_mat, N_mat, col_levels


def run_path_for(sweep_name, source, data_name, K, model_slug):
    return (
        RESULTS_BASE
        / sweep_name
        / source
        / data_name
        / f"K~{K}"
        / f"stan_file~{model_slug}"
    )


def load_kernel_summary(run_path):
    run_dir = Path(run_path)
    out_cols = ["component", "level", "mean", "median", "map_marginal", "map_joint", "lower", "upper"]

    def _empty():
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=out_cols)

    km_path = run_dir / "kernel_mode_summary.parquet"
    if km_path.exists():
        df_km = pd.read_parquet(km_path)
        if not df_km.empty and df_km["mean"].notna().any():
            result = df_km.rename(columns={"nu": "level", "ci_low": "lower", "ci_high": "upper"})
            for col in ["mean", "median", "map_marginal", "map_joint"]:
                if col not in result.columns:
                    result[col] = result.get("mean", np.nan)
            return result[out_cols].sort_values(["component", "level"])

    s_path = run_dir / "inference_summary.parquet"
    if not s_path.exists():
        return _empty()

    df_sum = pd.read_parquet(s_path)
    rows_mu = []
    rows_logit_mu = []
    rows_c = []

    pat_mu_comp = re.compile(r"^mu\[(\d+),(\d+)\]$")
    pat_mu_single = re.compile(r"^mu\[(\d+)\]$")
    pat_c_triplet = re.compile(r"^c\[(\d+),(\d+),(\d+)\]$")
    pat_c_pair = re.compile(r"^c\[(\d+),(\d+)\]$")
    pat_c_single = re.compile(r"^c\[(\d+)\]$")
    pat_logit_mu = re.compile(r"^logit_mu\[(\d+),(\d+)\]$")

    for idx, row in df_sum.iterrows():
        idx = str(idx)

        m = pat_mu_comp.match(idx)
        if m:
            rows_mu.append(
                {
                    "component": int(m.group(1)),
                    "level": int(m.group(2)),
                    "mean": float(row["Mean"]),
                    "median": float(row["50%"]),
                    "lower": float(row["5%"]),
                    "upper": float(row["95%"]),
                }
            )
            continue

        m = pat_mu_single.match(idx)
        if m:
            rows_mu.append(
                {
                    "component": 1,
                    "level": int(m.group(1)),
                    "mean": float(row["Mean"]),
                    "median": float(row["50%"]),
                    "lower": float(row["5%"]),
                    "upper": float(row["95%"]),
                }
            )
            continue

        m = pat_c_triplet.match(idx)
        if m:
            rows_c.append(
                {
                    "component": int(m.group(2)),
                    "level": int(m.group(3)),
                    "mean": float(row["Mean"]),
                    "median": float(row["50%"]),
                    "lower": float(row["5%"]),
                    "upper": float(row["95%"]),
                }
            )
            continue

        m = pat_c_pair.match(idx)
        if m:
            rows_c.append(
                {
                    "component": int(m.group(1)),
                    "level": int(m.group(2)),
                    "mean": float(row["Mean"]),
                    "median": float(row["50%"]),
                    "lower": float(row["5%"]),
                    "upper": float(row["95%"]),
                }
            )
            continue

        m = pat_c_single.match(idx)
        if m:
            rows_c.append(
                {
                    "component": 1,
                    "level": int(m.group(1)),
                    "mean": float(row["Mean"]),
                    "median": float(row["50%"]),
                    "lower": float(row["5%"]),
                    "upper": float(row["95%"]),
                }
            )
            continue

        m = pat_logit_mu.match(idx)
        if m:
            rows_logit_mu.append(
                {
                    "component": int(m.group(1)),
                    "level": int(m.group(2)),
                    "mean": float(logistic(row["Mean"])),
                    "median": float(logistic(row["50%"])),
                    "lower": float(logistic(row["5%"])),
                    "upper": float(logistic(row["95%"])),
                }
            )

    # Fallback preference: transformed kernels (mu) -> logit_mu -> empirical kernels (c).
    # `mu` tracks the global component kernels and is more stable for visual comparison.
    if rows_mu:
        base_rows = rows_mu
    elif rows_logit_mu:
        base_rows = rows_logit_mu
    elif rows_c:
        base_rows = rows_c
    else:
        return _empty()

    df = (
        pd.DataFrame(base_rows)
        .groupby(["component", "level"], as_index=False)[["mean", "median", "lower", "upper"]]
        .mean()
        .sort_values(["component", "level"])
    )
    for col in ["map_marginal", "map_joint"]:
        df[col] = df["median"]
    return df[out_cols]


def load_pi_summary(run_path):
    summary_path = Path(run_path) / "inference_summary.parquet"
    if not summary_path.exists():
        return None

    df = pd.read_parquet(summary_path)
    rows = []
    for idx, row in df.iterrows():
        m = re.match(r"^pi\[(\d+)\]$", str(idx))
        if m:
            rows.append(
                {
                    "component": int(m.group(1)),
                    "mean": float(row["Mean"]),
                    "median": float(row["50%"]),
                    "lower": float(row["5%"]),
                    "upper": float(row["95%"]),
                }
            )
    if not rows:
        return None
    return pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("component")


def aggregate_model_curve(kernel_df, pi_df, estimator_col="mean"):
    if kernel_df is None or kernel_df.empty:
        return None

    use_col = select_estimator_col(kernel_df, estimator_col)
    levels = np.sort(kernel_df["level"].unique())
    comps = np.sort(kernel_df["component"].unique())

    curve = pd.DataFrame({"level": levels})
    curve["fit"] = 0.0
    curve["lower"] = 0.0
    curve["upper"] = 0.0

    if pi_df is None or pi_df.empty:
        weights = {int(c): 1.0 / len(comps) for c in comps}
    else:
        weight_col = "median" if estimator_col in {"median", "map_marginal", "map_joint"} and "median" in pi_df.columns else "mean"
        weights = {int(r.component): float(getattr(r, weight_col)) for r in pi_df.itertuples()}
        total_w = sum(weights.get(int(c), 0.0) for c in comps)
        if total_w <= 0:
            weights = {int(c): 1.0 / len(comps) for c in comps}
        else:
            weights = {int(c): weights.get(int(c), 0.0) / total_w for c in comps}

    for c in comps:
        w = weights.get(int(c), 0.0)
        sub = kernel_df[kernel_df["component"] == c].sort_values("level")
        comp = pd.DataFrame(
            {
                "level": sub["level"].to_numpy(dtype=int),
                "fit": sub[use_col].to_numpy(dtype=float),
                "lower": sub["lower"].to_numpy(dtype=float),
                "upper": sub["upper"].to_numpy(dtype=float),
            }
        )
        curve = curve.merge(comp, on="level", how="left", suffixes=("", f"_c{c}"))
        curve["fit"] += w * curve[f"fit_c{c}"].fillna(0.0)
        curve["lower"] += w * curve[f"lower_c{c}"].fillna(0.0)
        curve["upper"] += w * curve[f"upper_c{c}"].fillna(0.0)
        curve = curve.drop(columns=[f"fit_c{c}", f"lower_c{c}", f"upper_c{c}"])

    return curve


def select_estimator_col(df, preferred="map_joint"):
    for col in [preferred, "map_marginal", "median", "mean"]:
        if col in df.columns and df[col].notna().any():
            return col
    return "mean"


def truncated_panel_ylim(obs_p, model_curves):
    finite_obs = obs_p[np.isfinite(obs_p)]
    y_max = float(finite_obs.max()) if finite_obs.size > 0 else 0.0
    for payload in model_curves.values():
        curve = payload.get("curve")
        if curve is None or curve.empty:
            continue
        for col in ("upper", "fit", "lower"):
            if col in curve.columns:
                arr = curve[col].to_numpy(dtype=float)
                if np.isfinite(arr).any():
                    y_max = max(y_max, float(np.nanmax(arr)))
    return 0.0, max(0.005, y_max) * 1.05


def logistic(x):
    return 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-x))


def binomial_ci_normal(m_obs, n_obs, z=1.96):
    total = m_obs + n_obs
    p_hat = np.divide(m_obs, total, out=np.zeros_like(total, dtype=float), where=total > 0)
    se = np.sqrt(
        np.divide(
            p_hat * (1.0 - p_hat),
            total,
            out=np.zeros_like(total, dtype=float),
            where=total > 0,
        )
    )
    lower = np.clip(p_hat - z * se, 0.0, 1.0)
    upper = np.clip(p_hat + z * se, 0.0, 1.0)
    return lower, upper


def empirical_curve_from_mn(M, N, mn_mode="incidence"):
    total = M + N
    with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
        base = np.where(total > 0, M / total, np.nan)

    mode = str(mn_mode).lower()
    if mode != "survival":
        return base

    # In survival framing, M/(M+N) is a per-level hazard.
    # Convert to cumulative adoption probability for comparability to model mu(nu).
    hazard = np.nan_to_num(base, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
    hazard = np.clip(hazard, 0.0, 1.0)
    return 1.0 - np.cumprod(1.0 - hazard)
```

```{python}
matrix_rows = []

for spec in TWITTER_SPECS:
    M_mat, N_mat, levels = load_twitter_mn_matrices(spec["q"], spec["metric"])
    if M_mat is None or N_mat is None:
        matrix_rows.append({"dataset": f"Twitter {spec['label']}", "figure": "missing M/N parquet files"})
        continue

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(13, 7.2), sharex=True, sharey=True)
    panels = [
        (M_mat, "M (raw counts)", "viridis"),
        (N_mat, "N (raw counts)", "magma"),
        (np.log1p(M_mat), "M (log1p counts)", "viridis"),
        (np.log1p(N_mat), "N (log1p counts)", "magma"),
    ]

    for ax, (mat, title, cmap) in zip(axes.flat, panels):
        im = ax.imshow(mat, aspect="auto", interpolation="nearest", cmap=cmap)
        ax.set_title(title)
        ax.set_xlabel("Exposure level")
        ax.set_ylabel("User row index")
        cbar = fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046, pad=0.04)
        cbar.ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)

    if levels:
        if len(levels) <= 20:
            tick_idx = np.arange(len(levels))
        else:
            tick_idx = np.linspace(0, len(levels) - 1, 10, dtype=int)
        tick_labels = [levels[i] for i in tick_idx]
        axes[1, 0].set_xticks(tick_idx)
        axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(tick_labels)
        axes[1, 1].set_xticks(tick_idx)
        axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(tick_labels)

    fig.suptitle(f"Twitter {spec['row_title']}", y=0.995)
    fig.tight_layout()

    out_path = FIG_DIR / f"twitter_mn_matrices_{spec['metric']}_03-08-26.png"
    fig.savefig(out_path, dpi=220, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.show()
    plt.close(fig)

    matrix_rows.append({"dataset": f"Twitter {spec['label']}", "figure": str(out_path)})
```

## Twitter Full-Only (Survival) vs Original Full

```{python}
#| label: twitter-fullonly-vs-original
#| fig-cap: "Twitter empirical adoption curves and support counts: original full pipeline vs new full-only survival preprocessing."

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 8), sharex=False)

for row_idx, spec in enumerate(TWITTER_SPECS):
    M_orig, N_orig = load_twitter_data(
        spec["q"], spec["metric"], run_kmax=50, base_dir=PIPELINE_TWITTER_FULL
    )
    M_surv, N_surv = load_twitter_data(
        spec["q"], spec["metric"], run_kmax=50, base_dir=PIPELINE_TWITTER_FULL_SURVIVAL
    )

    T_orig = M_orig + N_orig
    T_surv = M_surv + N_surv
    with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
        p_orig = np.where(T_orig > 0, M_orig / T_orig, np.nan)
        p_surv = np.where(T_surv > 0, M_surv / T_surv, np.nan)

    max_level = int(
        max(
            np.where(T_orig > 0)[0].max() + 1 if np.any(T_orig > 0) else 1,
            np.where(T_surv > 0)[0].max() + 1 if np.any(T_surv > 0) else 1,
        )
    )
    x = np.arange(1, max_level + 1)

    ax_left = axes[row_idx, 0]
    ax_left.plot(x, p_orig[:max_level], "-o", color="#4C78A8", ms=3, lw=1.8, label="Original full")
    ax_left.plot(x, p_surv[:max_level], "-o", color="#E45756", ms=3, lw=1.8, label="Full-only survival")
    ax_left.set_title(f"{spec['row_title']} | Empirical P(adopt|nu)")
    ax_left.set_xlabel("Exposure level")
    ax_left.set_ylabel("Adoption probability")
    ax_left.grid(alpha=0.2)
    ax_left.set_ylim(0, max(float(np.nanmax(p_orig[:max_level])), float(np.nanmax(p_surv[:max_level])), 0.005) * 1.2)

    ax_right = axes[row_idx, 1]
    ax_right.plot(x, T_orig[:max_level], "-o", color="#4C78A8", ms=3, lw=1.8, label="Original full")
    ax_right.plot(x, T_surv[:max_level], "-o", color="#E45756", ms=3, lw=1.8, label="Full-only survival")
    ax_right.set_title(f"{spec['row_title']} | Bin support (M+N)")
    ax_right.set_xlabel("Exposure level")
    ax_right.set_ylabel("Count")
    ax_right.set_yscale("log")
    ax_right.grid(alpha=0.2, which="both")

handles, labels = axes[0, 0].get_legend_handles_labels()
fig.legend(handles, labels, loc="upper center", ncol=2, framealpha=0.95, bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 1.02))
fig.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.97])

twitter_fullonly_cmp_fig = FIG_DIR / "twitter_fullonly_survival_vs_original_03-08-26.png"
fig.savefig(twitter_fullonly_cmp_fig, dpi=220, bbox_inches="tight")
twitter_fullonly_cmp_fig
```

## Twitter Fits

Curves use posterior-mean kernels (`mean` fallback chain in helper).  
Retry sweep is `K=1` only to avoid mixture-identifiability collapse seen previously.

```{python}
#| label: twitter-fit-comparison
#| fig-cap: "Twitter model fit comparison vs empirical adoption rates (SC and CC metrics)."

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 9), sharey=False)

for row_idx, spec in enumerate(TWITTER_SPECS):
    for col_idx, K in enumerate([1, 2]):
        ax = axes[row_idx, col_idx]

        model_curves = {}
        kmax = 0

        for model_slug, model_label, color in TWITTER_MODEL_SPECS:
            run_path = run_path_for(spec["sweep"], spec["source"], spec["data_name"], K, model_slug)
            kernel_df = load_kernel_summary(run_path)
            if kernel_df is None or kernel_df.empty:
                continue
            pi_df = load_pi_summary(run_path)
            curve = aggregate_model_curve(kernel_df, pi_df, estimator_col=ESTIMATOR)
            if curve is None or curve.empty:
                continue
            model_curves[model_label] = {
                "curve": curve,
                "color": color,
                "kernel_df": kernel_df,
                "pi_df": pi_df,
            }
            kmax = max(kmax, int(curve["level"].max()))

        if kmax == 0:
            ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "No fitted runs found", transform=ax.transAxes, ha="center", va="center")
            ax.set_axis_off()
            continue

        M, N = load_twitter_data(spec["q"], spec["metric"], run_kmax=kmax)
        total = M + N
        with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):
            obs_p = np.where(total > 0, M / total, np.nan)

        x = np.arange(1, kmax + 1)
        ax.bar(x, np.nan_to_num(obs_p, nan=0.0), width=0.84, color="0.86", alpha=0.9, label="Empirical", zorder=1)

        mask = total > 0
        if SHOW_EMPIRICAL_BANDS and np.any(mask):
            m_obs = M[mask]
            n_obs = N[mask]
            lower, upper = binomial_ci_normal(m_obs, n_obs)
            y = obs_p[mask]
            yerr = np.vstack([y - lower, upper - y])
            ax.errorbar(x[mask], y, yerr=yerr, fmt="none", ecolor="0.45", elinewidth=0.8, capsize=2, zorder=2)

        for model_label, payload in model_curves.items():
            curve = payload["curve"]
            color = payload["color"]

            # Show component-specific kernels for K>1 (dashed),
            # while keeping solid line as the mixture-averaged fit.
            if K > 1:
                kdf = payload["kernel_df"]
                comps = sorted(kdf["component"].unique())
                if len(comps) > 1:
                    comp_col = select_estimator_col(kdf, ESTIMATOR)
                    for comp in comps:
                        sub = kdf[kdf["component"] == comp].sort_values("level")
                        ax.plot(
                            sub["level"],
                            sub[comp_col],
                            "--",
                            color=color,
                            lw=1.0,
                            alpha=0.28,
                            zorder=3,
                            label=None,
                        )

            ax.plot(curve["level"], curve["fit"], "-o", color=color, lw=2.0, ms=3.2, label=model_label, zorder=5)
            if SHOW_MODEL_BANDS:
                ax.fill_between(curve["level"], curve["lower"], curve["upper"], color=color, alpha=0.10, zorder=4)

        y0, y1 = truncated_panel_ylim(obs_p, model_curves)
        ax.set_ylim(y0, y1)
        ax.set_title(f"{spec['row_title']} | K={K}")
        ax.set_xlabel("Exposure level")
        ax.set_ylabel("P(adopt | exposure)")
        ax.grid(alpha=0.2, zorder=0)

handles, labels = axes[0, 0].get_legend_handles_labels()
fig.legend(handles, labels, loc="upper center", ncol=4, framealpha=0.95, bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 1.02))
fig.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.97])

twitter_fig = FIG_DIR / "twitter_fit_comparison_03-08-26.png"
fig.savefig(twitter_fig, dpi=220, bbox_inches="tight")
twitter_fig
```

## Twitter Fits (Survival Sweeps)

For `K=2`, dashed lines show individual mixture components; solid lines show the mixture-averaged fit.

```{python}
#| label: twitter-fit-comparison-survival

for row_idx, spec in enumerate(TWITTER_SURVIVAL_SPECS):

    kmax = 0

        run_path = run_path_for(spec["sweep"], spec["source"], spec["data_name"], K, model_slug)
        kernel_df = load_kernel_summary(run_path)
        if kernel_df is None or kernel_df.empty:
            continue
        pi_df = load_pi_summary(run_path)
        curve = aggregate_model_curve(kernel_df, pi_df, estimator_col=ESTIMATOR)
        if curve is None or curve.empty:
            continue
        model_curves[model_label] = {
            "curve": curve,
            "color": color,
            "kernel_df": kernel_df,
            "pi_df": pi_df,
        }
        kmax = max(kmax, int(curve["level"].max()))

        continue

        spec["q"], spec["metric"], run_kmax=kmax, base_dir=spec["base_dir"]
    )

    ax.bar(x, np.nan_to_num(obs_p, nan=0.0), width=0.84, color="0.86", alpha=0.9, label="Empirical", zorder=1)
```

```{python}
SCORED_SWEEPS = [
    {"sweep": "research_sweep_oo_prior_np_v3_dropzero", "label": "v3 dropzero"},
    {"sweep": "research_sweep_oo_prior_np_v4_peakpush", "label": "v4 peakpush"},
    {"sweep": "research_sweep_oo_prior_np_v5_k3_refine", "label": "v5 k3 refine"},
]

SWEEP_COLORS = {
    "v3 dropzero": "#1f77b4",
    "v4 peakpush": "#ff7f0e",
    "v5 k3 refine": "#2ca02c",
}

score_frames = []
for spec in SCORED_SWEEPS:
    p = RESULTS_BASE / spec["sweep"] / "oo_fit_gap_summary.csv"
    if not p.exists():
        continue
    df_s = pd.read_csv(p)
    if df_s.empty:
        continue
    df_s["sweep"] = spec["sweep"]
    df_s["sweep_label"] = spec["label"]
    score_frames.append(df_s)

if not score_frames:
    print("No scored OO sweep summaries found.")
else:
    scores = pd.concat(score_frames, ignore_index=True)
    scores["K"] = pd.to_numeric(scores["K"], errors="coerce")
    metric_cols = ["weighted_mae", "tail_mae_k10plus", "peak_underfit"]
    scores_plot = scores.dropna(subset=metric_cols).copy()

    top12 = scores_plot.nsmallest(12, "weighted_mae").copy()
    top12["rank"] = np.arange(1, len(top12) + 1)
    top12[["rank", "sweep_label", "K", "weighted_mae", "tail_mae_k10plus", "peak_underfit", "instance_id"]]
```

```{python}
#| label: oo-fit-gap-scatter
#| fig-cap: "Pairwise trade-offs between weighted MAE, tail MAE, and peak underfit (lower is better)."

if "scores_plot" not in globals() or scores_plot.empty:
    print("No scored metrics available for plotting.")
else:
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(16, 4.8))

    pairs = [
        ("weighted_mae", "tail_mae_k10plus"),
        ("weighted_mae", "peak_underfit"),
        ("tail_mae_k10plus", "peak_underfit"),
    ]

    for ax, (x_col, y_col) in zip(axes, pairs):
        for sweep_label in sorted(scores_plot["sweep_label"].unique()):
            sub = scores_plot[scores_plot["sweep_label"] == sweep_label]
            ax.scatter(
                sub[x_col],
                sub[y_col],
                s=38,
                alpha=0.78,
                color=SWEEP_COLORS.get(sweep_label, "0.5"),
                label=sweep_label,
            )
        ax.set_xlabel(x_col)
        ax.set_ylabel(y_col)
        ax.grid(alpha=0.22)

    handles, labels = axes[0].get_legend_handles_labels()
    uniq = dict(zip(labels, handles))
    fig.legend(uniq.values(), uniq.keys(), loc="upper center", ncol=3, framealpha=0.95)
    fig.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.92])

    scatter_fig = FIG_DIR / "oo_fit_gap_metrics_scatter_03-08-26.png"
    fig.savefig(scatter_fig, dpi=220, bbox_inches="tight")
    scatter_fig
```

```{python}
#| label: oo-fit-gap-top12-bars
#| fig-cap: "Top-12 candidates by weighted MAE, with corresponding tail MAE and peak underfit."

if "top12" not in globals() or top12.empty:
    print("No ranked candidates available.")
else:
    top12 = top12.reset_index(drop=True)
    x = np.arange(len(top12))
    colors = [SWEEP_COLORS.get(s, "0.5") for s in top12["sweep_label"]]
    labels = [f"{r.sweep_label} | K={int(r.K)}" for r in top12.itertuples()]

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(14, 10), sharex=True)
    metrics = [
        ("weighted_mae", "Weighted MAE"),
        ("tail_mae_k10plus", "Tail MAE (k>=10)"),
        ("peak_underfit", "Peak underfit"),
    ]

    for ax, (metric, title) in zip(axes, metrics):
        ax.bar(x, top12[metric], color=colors, alpha=0.9)
        ax.set_ylabel(title)
        ax.grid(alpha=0.22, axis="y")

    axes[-1].set_xticks(x)
    axes[-1].set_xticklabels(labels, rotation=32, ha="right", fontsize=8)
    axes[0].set_title("Top-12 by weighted MAE (lower is better across all panels)")

    fig.tight_layout()
    top12_fig = FIG_DIR / "oo_fit_gap_metrics_top12_03-08-26.png"
    fig.savefig(top12_fig, dpi=220, bbox_inches="tight")
top12_fig
```

```{python}
#| label: compare-og-vs-refit
#| fig-cap: "Saved figure-set comparison. Left column = OG snapshot, right column = weighted-refit rerun."
#| warning: false

from matplotlib.image import imread
from IPython.display import display

compare_specs = [
    ("twitter_fit_comparison_03-08-26.png", "Twitter fits"),
    ("oo_fit_eb_vs_weak_03-08-26.png", "OO fits"),
    ("twitter_mn_matrices_k_03-08-26.png", "Twitter M/N (k)"),
    ("twitter_mn_matrices_kappa_03-08-26.png", "Twitter M/N (kappa)"),
    ("oo_mn_matrices_03-08-26.png", "OO M/N"),
]

for fname, title in compare_specs:
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(8.8, 6.6), constrained_layout=True)
    fig.suptitle(title, fontsize=12, y=1.02)
    og_path = FIG_DIR_OG / fname
    new_path = FIG_DIR / fname

    for ax, p, col_title in (
        [
            (axes[0], og_path, "OG"),
            (axes[1], new_path, "Weighted Refit"),
        ]
    ):
        if p.exists():
            ax.imshow(imread(p), aspect="auto")
            ax.set_aspect("auto")
            ax.set_title(col_title, fontsize=11)
            ax.axis("off")
        else:
            ax.text(0.5, 0.5, f"Missing:\n{p.name}", ha="center", va="center", transform=ax.transAxes)
            ax.set_title(col_title, fontsize=11)
            ax.axis("off")
    display(fig)
    plt.close(fig)
```
